# LureEval schema fixture

`receipt-v1.schema.json` is an unchanged copy of
`immu4989/lurebench/spec/lureeval-receipt-v1.schema.json` at producer commit
`811260a4655c7ce51b247551f0b0563629fcd6bf` (Apache-2.0).

Tests prefer the installed LureBench wheel's schema. This fallback supports
editable dependency installations without requiring an adjacent checkout.
